packageRules.description: One weekly PR (Fridays) for all non-major npm & GitHub Actions updates
Majors gated behind the Dependency Dashboard; grouped into one PR when approved
Extra npm supply-chain age gate (mirrors Yarn's npmMinimalAgeGate: 7d)

Consciously kept complete/frozen packages — no maintained replacement exists, so exempt them from abandonment flagging (events has zero deps; buffer/stream-browserify are the standard browser polyfills; saxes is jsdom's XML parser)

Block TypeScript 7.0.x — the Go-native compiler ships without the programmatic compiler API, so typescript-eslint (type-aware linting in api/pubsub/logger/email), ts-node (dev/CLI/migrations across every backend), and @vercel/ncc (all GitHub Actions builds) cannot run against it. Unblock once 7.1 restores the API.
